title: A worker's own build and tests never queue behind trials holding the host's heavy-job slots
description: Two merge trials hold both ordinary host heavy-job slots and a batch gate holds the reservation; a worker session's npm run build and its affected tests complete at once without waiting, and master status names the jobs and projects holding the slots and the limit they share.

steps.name: a worker builds and tests while trials fill the host budget, and master status names the holders
